in_sanskrit.name: अजिनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Ajinath' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'aji' (unconquerable, invincible) and 'nath' (lord). Thus, Ajinath means 'The Invincible Lord'.

in_hindi.name: अजीनाथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Ajinath' in Hindi is composed of the words 'ajit' (unconquerable, invincible) and 'nath' (lord). Hence, Ajinath means 'The Unconquerable Lord' in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: அஜினாத
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name 'Ajinath' is derived from the words 'aji' (invincible) and 'nathar' (lord). Therefore, Ajinath means 'The Invincible Lord' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: అజినాథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name 'Ajinath' is composed of the words 'aji' (invincible) and 'natha' (lord). Thus, Ajinath means 'The Invincible Lord' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Ajinath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajinath is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Aji' meaning lord and 'Nath' meaning master or ruler. In Hindu mythology, Ajinath is the collective name for all the gods in the Hindu pantheon. This name embodies power, divinity, and the supreme ruler of the universe.
